segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I had you at 38 users today and you’re looking to add the customer ops team before the September rollout. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: Close. We counted again this morning. It’s 42 total seats, not 38. Thirty-two need full access, ten are managers who mostly need dashboards and exports.

segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Got it. For your plan the seat type is the same, so 42 seats. At the annual rate we discussed, that’s $68 per seat per month, billed annually. Comes to $34,272 for the year.

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation fee was separate, right?

segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Right, one-time $4,500 for onboarding. That includes the data import, two admin trainings, and one end-user webinar. No extra charge for the sandbox you asked about.

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: That works. We need the invoice dated after August 15 if possible. Our fiscal approval is already in, but accounting won’t pay anything dated before then.

segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s fine. I’ll set the subscription start date as September 1, invoice date August 16, net 30 terms. Your first training would be the week of August 26 if we get signatures by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: Next Friday is August 9, yep. Our VP can sign electronically. The only contract item she asked me to confirm is the renewal language. It doesn’t auto-renew for three years or anything like that, correct?

segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Correct. It’s a 12-month initial term, then it renews annually unless either side gives 30 days’ notice before the renewal date. No multi-year lock unless you choose one.

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send me the order form with 42 seats, the $4,500 onboarding, September 1 start, and August 16 invoice date. I’ll route it today.

segments.speaker: Avery, Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it in the next hour, and I’ll include the implementation schedule and the security packet link in the same email so your VP has the full set.

segments.speaker: Dana, Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If it matches what we just covered, I don’t expect any issues.
